name: A Fine Mess
summary: In Gnomeregan, Kernobee lies battered among the troggs after an ambush by Dark Iron dwarves. His rescue brings word of their work on a subterranean drilling rig, bound for Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Battered Survivor
sections.body: You find Kernobee in Gnomeregan’s dormitory, beaten and groggy. Dark Iron dwarves ambushed the goblin and left him among the feral troggs. He needs a friendly face to survive the return through the contaminated corridors.

sections.title: Subterranean Schemes
sections.body: Kernobee carries word of the Dark Iron clan’s work on a massive super rig beneath Dun Morogh. He escapes across the sea to Ratchet to warn the goblin engineer Tinkerwiz, and sends you south to Booty Bay with news for the goblin engineer Scooty.

faq.answer: Kernobee is a goblin found beaten nearly to death in Gnomeregan. Dark Iron dwarves ambushed him and left him among the troggs before he was rescued.
You need to guide Kernobee through Gnomeregan’s hostile halls toward the Clockwerk Run exit and the upper entrance corridors.

faq.q: Why were the Dark Iron dwarves involved?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron dwarves were helping design and build an enormous super rig drill underground. Kernobee discovered their plot before they ambushed him.

faq.q: Where does Kernobee go after escaping?
faq.answer: After reaching safety, Kernobee travels across the sea to Ratchet in the Barrens to warn Tinkerwiz about the Dark Iron involvement in the subterranean drilling rig.

faq.q: Why must you report to Scooty in Booty Bay?
faq.answer: Scooty is a goblin engineer in Booty Bay who works with Tinkerwiz on high-tech subterranean equipment and transponder networks.

faq.q: How does this relate to Mekgineer Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: Scooty knows of the threat Mekgineer Thermaplugg poses inside Gnomeregan. Helping Kernobee provides aid and supplies to adventurers preparing to return and confront the treacherous Mekgineer.

angles.text: As a gnome, rescuing a survivor from Gnomeregan’s contaminated depths is a duty of honor, especially with Dark Iron infiltrators and feral troggs threatening him.
As an Alliance member, you learn that Emperor Thaurissan’s agents are sabotaging Alliance recovery efforts in Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you may worry to learn that Dark Iron machinists are building a massive super rig underground.
